sense: something pledged for a loan or a debt

evidence: Tac. H. 3.65: rem alicujus pignorī accipere (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: To pledge something is pignorī dare or oppōnere; to take it as security, pignorī accipere.

terms.gloss: a bond, a written guarantee (in law)
evidence: Cic. Fam. 7.18.1: Graeculam tibi mīsī cautiōnem chīrographī meī (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: ager oppositust pignorī ob decem minās
phrases.english: the farm is pledged as security for ten minae

sources: Lewis & Short: pignus · Lewis & Short: cautio
